caption:
You sent paid traffic to your homepage. That's a maze with a budget attached.

Your homepage is built for someone who already knows who you are and is browsing. Paid traffic is the opposite: a stranger, mid-scroll, who clicked one specific promise and has about eight seconds of patience. Dropping them into a menu with eleven options and an About page is how you pay for a click twice and convert it zero times.

What the page needs, and nothing else:

→ The same promise that was in the ad, in the same words
→ What happens next, in one line
→ One action, above the fold, repeated once further down
→ Proof that someone like them already did it

No nav bar. No "explore our services". No carousel of stock photos.

The ad and the page are one sentence split across two screens. If they don't match, the click was the last thing that worked.
